In this much time, you will waste 28 hours on Instagram. Or, in those same two weeks, just practice English with me for 15 minutes daily. By the end, you can speak fluent English. The choice is yours.] Speaker B: मुझसे होगा नहीं यार। English मुश्किल है। हिम्मत ही नहीं होती। [I won't be able to do it, friend. English is difficult. The second week, practice with me. I am your AI coach. Available 24 hours. 5 AM, 12 AM, whenever you get time. And I will never say 'you don't even know this much.' And the biggest thing, you don't have to feel embarrassed speaking wrong English in front of a stranger, right? Not in front of the boss, not in front of a colleague, not in front of a girl. Just you and me, private, safe, at your speed.] Speaker B: तुम सच कह रही हो। सीखने का मौका मिला ही नहीं कभी। [You are telling the truth. I never got the opportunity to learn.] Speaker A: अब मिलेगा। रोज़। चौदह दिन में perfect English नहीं होगी, झूठ नहीं बोलूँगी। पर इतना होगा, तू बोल पायेगा। बिना रुके, बिना डरे, बिना शर्माए। और वही काफी है शुरू करने के लिए। वही दो हफ्ते Instagram पे गंवा दे या English बोल के निकाल। English Seekho app download कर और सिर्फ एक रूपए के trial से शुरू कर। [Now you will. Daily. You won't have perfect English in 14 days, I won't lie. But this much will happen, you will be able to speak. Without stopping, without fear, without embarrassment. And that is enough to start. Waste those same two weeks on Instagram or spend them speaking English. Download the English Seekho app and start with just a one-rupee trial.] Speaker C: Install Now पे क्लिक करो और अभी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]
